messages:
rachel: Quick sync: co-hosted event with AtlasCloud next Thursday 10:00am PT. Format: 15m partner keynote, 20m live integration lab, 10m Q&A. Need volunteers for tech dry-run Wednesday 2pm PT.

diego: I can do Wed 2pm. My focus: marketplace provisioning flow + verifying atlas scopes for marketplace listing. Also will check our webhook consumer for order webhooks.

nora: I'll own swag + customs. Order: 150 attendee kits (sticker pack, notebook, travel charger). Shipping note: 50 kits to EU, declare value $18/kit. I'll upload pro-forma invoices to shared drive.

alan: Tech items: confirm partner will call our hosted API, but want failover to dedicated zone if latency > 250ms. Need to test routing policy and a short-lived demo token. Also confirm their SSO redirect URI is whitelisted on staging.

rachel: Diego can you paste the redirect URI? Need it in allowlist before dry-run.

diego: Redirect URI: https://apps.atlascloud.io/auth/callback. I added it to staging allowlist.

nora: Courier ETA day-of: 08:00am local. On-site team will assemble kits starting 8:30am. Need volunteer for final QA at 9:15am.

alan: For failover smoke on staging use:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-atlas-176954' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-beta","prompt":"integration failover test","max_tokens":24,"simulate_load":true}'
```
Expect initial route to hosted, then fallback to `redwood-dedicated-eu` when simulate_load triggers. Watch `routing-decisions` and `failover-events` streams.

ops-bot: Dry-run reminder scheduled Wed 14:00 (1769625600). I will ping this channel 15 minutes before. :bell:

rachel: Dry-run agenda (Wed 2pm, 30m):
- 14:00 start + quick intros (5m)
- 14:05 OIDC & token smoke (5m)
- 14:10 induce failover and observe logs (10m)
- 14:20 presenter mic + slide handoffs (5m)
- 14:25 final swag QA assignment (5m)

diego: I'll provision a 6-hour demo token and DM the partner speaker at 09:45am day-of.

nora: I'll upload customs docs and the packing manifest by EOD. Also attaching printable partner note for attendee kits: "Try Redwood on the AtlasCloud marketplace for a free trial and partner credits."

rachel: Great. If no blockers, we lock the runbook. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
